*Roti sai mai* is `a popular Thai street food dessert consisting of sweet, colorful spun sugar (resembling cotton candy) wrapped inside a paper-thin, soft, pan-fried crepe (roti)` . The fluffy, sugary threads pair perfectly with the slightly savory and chewy crepe.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roti_sai_mai) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roti_sai_mai)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/FoodNetwork/posts/the-making-of-roti-sai-mai-a-pandan-flavored-crepe-traditionally-filled-with-tha/10159644592146727/)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/chopsticktravel/posts/ancient-thai-candy-making-roti-sai-mai-ayutthaya-thailand-/1431202851700153/)[[4]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DOGI8HPEwGN/?hl=en)

**What it is made of:** 

- **The Sai Mai:** Meaning "silk threads," this is fine, silky spun sugar often made from cane or palm sugar. It comes in various colors, most commonly white or pastel shades.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roti_sai_mai) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZwwBST-282A)
- **The Roti:** This is a delicate, paper-thin flatbread that acts as a wrapper. It is slightly salted and often comes in a bright green color, scented and flavored with pandan.[](https://www.facebook.com/chopsticktravel/posts/ancient-thai-candy-making-roti-sai-mai-ayutthaya-thailand-/1431202851700153/) [[1]](https://www.sbs.com.au/food/article/thai-roti-sai-mai-hand-made-fairy-floss/fthfbmuqa)[[2]](https://www.atlasobscura.com/foods/roti-sai-mai-candy-floss-crepe-thailand)[[3]](https://www.tasteatlas.com/roti-sai-mai)

**How it's served and eaten:**   
The sweet spun sugar and the thin crepes are usually sold separately in plastic bags. To eat it, you simply take a pinch of the sugary floss, place it in the center of the roti, roll it up burrito-style, and eat it fresh.[](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DVXgAdoEZVq/?hl=en) [[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DVXgAdoEZVq/?hl=en)**Where it comes from:**   
It is widely considered the signature dessert of Ayutthaya, the ancient capital of Thailand, and was originally introduced by the Muslim community.[](https://guide.michelin.com/th/en/article/features/what-is-ayutthaya-s-roti-sai-mai-and-where-to-find-them) [[1]](https://guide.michelin.com/th/en/article/features/what-is-ayutthaya-s-roti-sai-mai-and-where-to-find-them)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/chopsticktravel/posts/this-traditional-thai-candy-is-called-roti-sai-mai-and-its-incredible-to-see-he-/1190366635783777/)For a visual look at the fascinating, highly-skilled process of stretching the spun sugar and cooking the crepes:![Related video thumbnail](https://encrypted-tbn3.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSUT9I0jhe6WmUKfv9pBd73Y6P7GCvExCfqSGuT1YIlssomenXD)
